exposure: rate of using continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) rather than intubation as first mode of respiratory support
cohort: The study included 19,099 neonates born between 25 and 32 weeks' gestation and admitted to 25 neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) in Australia and New Zealand between 2007 and 2013.
finding: Higher admission volumes were associated with lower odds of death or survival with bronchopulmonary dysplasia in the 25-28 week gestation group.
